title: Risk-Averse Inference-Time Diffusion Model Alignment with Finite-Sample Guarantees
abstract: arXiv:2610.17579v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Inference-time alignment steers diffusion models toward downstream objectives without costly fine-tuning, but existing methods typically optimize expected cost (or reward) without explicitly controlling tail risk. In this work, we propose a risk-averse framework for inference-time alignment of diffusion models that balances expected cost and Conditional Value-at-Risk (CVaR) under trajectory-level Kullback-Leibler regularization. We characterize the optimal path distribution and reverse transitions as functions of the CVaR threshold, reducing the alignment problem to a one-dimensional optimization problem over the threshold. We show that this one-dimensional optimization problem can be nonconvex in general, establish sufficient conditions for convexity, and introduce quadratic regularization to enable efficient derivative-free ternary search. translated_abstract: 推理时对齐无需代价高昂的微调即可引导扩散模型实现下游目标，但现有方法通常只优化期望代价（或奖励），而未显式控制尾部风险。在本工作中，我们提出了一种用于扩散模型推理时对齐的风险规避框架，该框架在轨迹级Kullback-Leibler正则化下平衡期望代价与条件风险价值（CVaR）。我们将最优路径分布和反向转移刻画为CVaR阈值的函数，从而将对齐问题简化为关于该阈值的一维优化问题。我们证明该一维优化问题在一般情况下可能是非凸的，建立了凸性的充分条件，并引入二次正则化以实现高效的无导数三元搜索。在适当的假设下，我们为阈值优化提供了有限样本保证，并验证了…
tldr: 该论文提出了一个风险规避的扩散模型推理时对齐框架，在轨迹级KL正则化下平衡期望代价与条件风险价值（CVaR），将对齐问题化简为关于CVaR阈值的一维优化，并给出了阈值优化的有限样本理论保证。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes a risk-averse framework for inference-time diffusion model alignment that balances expected cost and CVaR under trajectory-level KL regularization, reduces the alignment problem to a one-dimensional threshold optimization, and provides finite-sample guarantees for threshold optimization.
